searchText: path-based database storage systems will not be able to proof everything all the time. thats the tradeoff we made with Bonsai for instance It's the same with Geth to elaborate a little bit on my point 3 above, see this feature request: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/615 yes I agree we should have something related to subscriptions see also https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/496 OpenRPC can't specify eth_subscribe right now the feature request you linked kind of matches one of the points I tried to raise in the doc: there will sometimes be feature requests which are really hard to implement without some sort of deep indexing in the client. for this particular one, in geth, we would need to attach a tracer to all block processing to catch these updates pretty much same here, but thats just a plugin for us would receipts filtering and subscription be easier to implement? alchemy for example provides this: https://docs.alchemy.com/reference/alchemy-minedtransactions yeah that's easier because we already have a system for receipt events (the log filtering) for purposes of standardization, requests which are hard to implement can be a problem. I don't think we'll ever agree among all clients on the details of a new subscription like this. It's just too much. that said, we have gotten pretty far already with what's there in that case, i think there might still be value in spec'ing it out but leaving it as optional. that way RPC providers can rely on all clients that DO support it, doing so consistently, and they can just route around the ones that don't. so you would say the profiles are a good idea? then there would also be the question who gets to decide on these proposals yes, i like the idea of profiles. would like to hear more about how they differ from a namespace
